content: 1. A systematic review and modeling analysis published in The Lancet Global Health in 2019 examined the global levels of preterm birth in 2014. The findings were detailed in volume 7, issue 1, on pages e37 to e46. 2. Anindya K, Marthias T, Vellakkal S, Carvalho N, Atun R, Morgan A, and colleagues conducted a comparative analysis of socioeconomic inequalities in effective service coverage for reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health across 39 lowand middle-income countries. This study was published in EClinicalMedicine in 2021, volume 40, article 101103. 3. Arsenault C, Jordan K, Lee D, Dinsa G, Manzi F, Marchant T, and collaborators analyzed equity in the quality of antenatal care using data from 91 national household surveys. Their findings were published in The Lancet Global Health in 2018, volume 6, issue 11, on pages e1186 to e1195.
